title: No One Is Counting: Toward an Adverse Advice Reporting System for Medical Harms Linked to Large Language Models
summary: People ask language models for medical advice every day, but when that advice causes harm, nothing records it. This Perspective proposes a reporting system for those harms: a taxonomy of harms and near misses, a tiered privacy model for reporters, and a data architecture that turns scattered reports into safety signals regulators and developers can act on.
